findings.claim: Third-quarter 2026 revenue was $26.701 million, down from $71.707 million a year earlier; bitcoin-mining revenue was $20.849 million versus $71.707 million, and HPC leasing revenue was $5.852 million versus none.
findings.source_title: Cipher Digital Inc. Form 10-Q for the quarter ended September 30, 2026

findings.claim: Net loss for the nine months ended September 30, 2026 was $350.249 million, and the third-quarter operating loss was $71.915 million; third-quarter net income of $31.596 million included a $127.180 million gain on the change in fair value of the warrant liability, while diluted earnings per share were a loss of $0.22.
findings.source_title: Cipher Digital Inc. Form 10-Q for the quarter ended September 30, 2026

findings.claim: In October 2025 Cipher Black Pearl LLC signed a 15-year lease with an investment-grade hyperscaler for about 300 gross megawatts at the Black Pearl facility, and the initial phase commenced in August 2026, which is when the company began recognizing HPC lease revenue.
findings.source_title: Cipher Digital Inc. Form 10-Q for the quarter ended September 30, 2026

findings.claim: In September 2026 Cipher amended the Fluidstack lease at Barber Lake so data halls are expected between the fourth quarter of 2026 and the first quarter of 2027, signed a binding 10-year follow-on lease with a leading AI lab, and agreed to bear the first $359.3 million of costs above the initial budget, with the tenant reimbursing 50% of any excess over the combined 20-year term.
findings.source_title: Cipher Digital Inc. Form 10-Q for the quarter ended September 30, 2026

findings.claim: Cipher said the Barber Lake lease amendment increases total contracted revenue at that site to approximately $9.1 billion, including about $5.2 billion of incremental rent, and that construction remains on track for the amended milestones.
findings.source_title: Cipher Digital Provides Third Quarter 2026 Business Update

findings.claim: At September 30, 2026, outstanding principal of long-term borrowings was $6.016 billion, including $1.733 billion of 7.125% Cipher Compute notes due 2030, $2.000 billion of 6.125% Black Pearl notes due 2031, and $810 million of 6.000% Stingray notes due 2031, and nine-month interest expense, net of capitalized interest, was $184.9 million versus $3.2 million a year earlier.
findings.source_title: Cipher Digital Inc. Form 10-Q for the quarter ended September 30, 2026

findings.claim: Under an at-the-market program sized for aggregate gross proceeds of up to $725.7 million, Cipher received $129.2 million of net proceeds in the nine months ended September 30, 2026 from the sale of 5,496,993 shares at an average net price of $23.50.
findings.source_title: Cipher Digital Inc. Form 10-Q for the quarter ended September 30, 2026

findings.claim: On October 16, 2026 Cipher issued $850.0 million of 0.00% convertible senior notes due November 1, 2032 with an initial conversion price of about $15.31, paid about $89.7 million for capped calls with an initial cap of $28.35, and exchanged about $165.9 million of its 1.75% 2030 notes for about 40.7 million shares, leaving about $6.6 million of those notes outstanding.
findings.source_title: Cipher Digital Inc. Form 8-K filed October 16, 2026

findings.claim: On October 16, 2026 Cipher elected physical settlement as the default method for conversions of its remaining 1.75% notes due 2030 and its 0.00% notes due 2031.
findings.source_title: Cipher Digital Inc. Form 8-K filed October 16, 2026

findings.claim: Google holds a warrant, issued for backstopping Fluidstack lease payments and amended on November 20, 2025, to buy 24,178,576 shares at $0.01, with the warrant liability valued at $504.880 million on September 30, 2026; delivery of shares to settle 2030 notes on October 16, 2026 increased the underlying shares by about 2.0 million, and Cipher must issue more shares or pay cash if the warrant value is below $435.0 million at the start of the exercise period.
findings.source_title: Cipher Digital Inc. Form 10-Q for the quarter ended September 30, 2026

findings.claim: At September 30, 2026 Cipher had $656.009 million of cash and cash equivalents, $1,719.403 million of current restricted cash, and $477.182 million of non-current restricted cash; restricted cash is note proceeds that cannot be used for general corporate purposes outside specified site developments, the $200 million revolver was undrawn, and management said resources, project financing, bitcoin inflows, and at-the-market sales should cover operating and capital needs for at least 12 months from issuance.
findings.source_title: Cipher Digital Inc. Form 10-Q for the quarter ended September 30, 2026

findings.claim: Operating activities used $283.194 million of cash in the nine months ended September 30, 2026, purchases of property and equipment were $2,517.241 million, and construction-related supplier commitments were about $1,610.1 million.
findings.source_title: Cipher Digital Inc. Form 10-Q for the quarter ended September 30, 2026

findings.claim: Bitcoin holdings fell to about 310 bitcoin, fair value $25.9 million, at September 30, 2026 from 1,433 bitcoin, fair value $125.4 million, at December 31, 2025, and nine-month bitcoin sale proceeds were $168.941 million with $47.251 million of realized losses.
findings.source_title: Cipher Digital Inc. Form 10-Q for the quarter ended September 30, 2026

findings.claim: Cipher stated that it is not a party to any material legal proceedings and is not aware of any pending or threatened claims, and that it does not believe there is a reasonable possibility of a material loss from ordinary-course claims.
findings.source_title: Cipher Digital Inc. Form 10-Q for the quarter ended September 30, 2026

findings.claim: Cipher said its development pipeline totals about 5.9 gigawatts, that ERCOT's Batch Zero process gave Colchis a conditional base-load classification for 1 gigawatt and conditional studied-load classifications for another 1.6 gigawatts, and that it acquired the 70-megawatt Horizon site in Texas with energization expected in 2029.
findings.source_title: Cipher Digital Provides Third Quarter 2026 Business Update

findings.claim: In March 2026 a Cipher subsidiary signed a 15-year lease with an investment-grade hyperscaler for another Texas HPC site, with phased delivery expected to begin in 2027, and the 100-megawatt Stingray data center is expected to commence in 2027.
findings.source_title: Cipher Digital Inc. Form 10-Q for the quarter ended September 30, 2026

upcoming_catalysts.event: Barber Lake data halls are expected to be delivered between the fourth quarter of 2026 and the first quarter of 2027 under the amended Fluidstack lease.
The 100-megawatt Stingray data center is expected to commence in 2027.
Stingray shell construction is expected to be completed in the fourth quarter of 2026.
Phased delivery under the March 2026 investment-grade hyperscaler lease is expected to begin in 2027.

On or about December 31, 2026 Cipher will calculate 2026 executive performance shares, with one-third vesting then and the next installment on March 31, 2027; earned shares can range from 0% to 225% of the 2,179,406 units granted.

policy_links.policy: ERCOT Batch Zero large-load interconnection classifications
policy_links.bottleneck: grid interconnection and large-load classification before pipeline sites can energize
policy_links.revenue_mechanism: A conditional classification is a step toward powering sites Cipher intends to lease, but the company has not reported revenue from the classified pipeline sites.

key_risks.risk: Cipher bears the first $359.3 million of Barber Lake costs above the original budget, and failure to deliver HPC halls on the amended schedule can trigger lease remedies while the sites are still being financed with secured project debt.

Long-term borrowing principal was $6.016 billion at September 30, 2026 and nine-month interest expense was $184.9 million, against $86.376 million of nine-month revenue and $283.194 million of operating cash use.

Shareholders face dilution from the at-the-market program, the October 2026 issuance of $850 million of converts at a $15.31 conversion price, the 40.7 million shares issued to retire 2030 notes, physical settlement of the 2031 notes, and Google's $0.01 warrants.

Bitcoin-mining revenue fell to $20.849 million in the third quarter from $71.707 million a year earlier, while HPC leasing contributed only $5.852 million, so the shift in the core business is still early.

dilution_events_last_12m.description: At-the-market sales of 5,496,993 shares for $129.2 million of net proceeds at an average net price of $23.50 during the nine months ended September 30, 2026, under a program allowing aggregate gross proceeds of up to $725.7 million.

October 16, 2026 issuance of $850.0 million principal of 0.00% convertible senior notes due 2032 at an initial conversion price of about $15.31, plus capped calls costing about $89.7 million with a $28.35 cap, and exchange of about $165.9 million of 1.75% 2030 notes for about 40.7 million shares. The same 8-K changes the default settlement of the 2030 and 2031 notes to physical shares.

notes: The September 30 balance sheet still shows $172.5 million of 2030 convertible notes because the October 16 exchange and the $850 million 2032 notes closed after the quarter. The $1.3 billion 0.00% 2031 notes were issued on September 30, 2025, just outside a trailing twelve-month issuance window, and remain outstanding. The 10-Q does not name the Black Pearl or March 2026 hyperscaler tenants. The November 2 press release rounds third-quarter revenue to $27 million; the 10-Q figure is $26.701 million. Management's twelve-month liquidity statement is not a going-concern warning. No delisting notice was found in the filings reviewed. Google's backstop of Fluidstack payments is recorded as a $544.5 million noncurrent asset.
